title: BCAAs: are they WORTH your money? 💸
caption:
BCAAs are 3 of the 9 essential amino acids. To build muscle you need all 9, and reviews find BCAAs add little if you already eat enough protein. Do you take BCAAs? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 4
